title.en: Milligrams, quintals, tonnes and word problems
How much can an ant carry?

text.en: An ant weighs only 1 to 5 milligrams, yet it carries things much heavier than itself! A gold ornament is measured in milligrams, while a truck of rice is measured in tonnes. Today we learn the very small and the very big units, and solve shopping problems.

For very light things we use the milligram (mg): 1 g = 1,000 mg. Medicine ingredients and gold ornaments are measured this way. A sugar sachet of 5 g is 5,000 mg.
Converting g to mg is like kg to g. 4 g 100 mg = 4,000 mg + 100 mg = 4,100 mg, and 10 g 500 mg = 10,500 mg.
For very heavy things: 100 kg = 1 quintal and 10 quintals = 1 tonne = 1,000 kg. So 5,000 kg = 50 quintals = 5 tonnes, and 9,000 kg = 90 quintals = 9 tonnes. The whole ladder is: 1,000 mg = 1 g, 1,000 g = 1 kg, 100 kg = 1 quintal, 10 quintals = 1 tonne.
The King's weight puzzle: on his birthday the king donates wheat equal to 10 times his weight. If he gives 800 kg, his weight is 800 / 10 = 80 kg. Last year he gave 780 kg, so he weighed 78 kg. He gained 80 - 78 = 2 kg in a year.
Adding weights: Rathna bought 2 kg 500 g and 1 kg 750 g of rice. Add kg: 2 + 1 = 3 kg. Add g: 500 + 750 = 1,250 g = 1 kg 250 g. Total 4 kg 250 g.
Another way: change to grams. 2,500 g + 1,750 g = 4,250 g = 4 kg 250 g. Both methods give the same answer, so pick the one you like.
Subtracting weights: how much extra rice did she buy for the household than for Pongal? 2 kg 500 g - 1 kg 750 g = 2,500 g - 1,750 g = 750 g.
We can add and subtract only like quantities: kg with kg, g with g, mg with mg. If you cannot subtract the small units, regroup one bigger unit into the smaller one.

problem.en: Rathna bought 2 kg 500 g rice and 1 kg 750 g rice. Find the total and how much more the first lot is.

why.en: Change both to grams, add, then change back to kg and g.
Subtract the smaller weight from the bigger one.

prompt.en: A truck carries 5,000 kg of wheat. Explain how many quintals and tonnes that is.

commonMisconceptions.en: Mixing up quintal (100 kg) and tonne (1,000 kg)

points.en: 1,000 mg = 1 g; 1,000 g = 1 kg; 100 kg = 1 quintal; 10 quintals = 1 tonne.
Add or subtract like units; regroup when needed.
Word problems: find what is asked, convert to one unit, calculate, convert back, check.
